mainEntity.name: Does Mac have speech to text built in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. macOS includes Dictation for text entry and Voice Control for hands-free Mac operation.

mainEntity.name: Is Gojo speech to text or transcription?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gojo is speech-to-text for the active field. It is not a transcript workspace for meeting archives.

mainEntity.name: Can speech to text on Mac be private?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be, but only when the selected workflow processes speech locally and does not store or send audio elsewhere. Check the exact setting or product documentation.

blocks.label: Short answer
blocks.copy: Mac speech-to-text is available through built-in Dictation, Voice Control, and third-party apps. Use Apple Dictation first for quick text entry. Use Gojo when you want local recognition and text inserted into the focused field. Use a transcript app when recordings and exports matter.
points: Local speech-to-text in everyday apps: Gojo.

blocks.text: How Gojo handles speech to text

content.s: Gojo performs recognition with a downloaded local model and inserts the result into the current text field. That makes it useful for messages, notes, browser forms, and drafts where opening a separate transcript app would add friction. For the deeper privacy angle, read
